subject: Order form amendment request — capacity split, price rebalance, and SOW edits
messages:
From: Maria Garcia <maria.garcia@healthspan.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@healthspan.com
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Order form amendment — capacity split & SOW update

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the time earlier. Attached is a first-pass amendment (HealthSpan_Amendment_Draft_v1.docx) and a PDF with our inline redlines (HealthSpan_Amendment_Redlines.pdf). High-level asks from our side:

- Add 200 reserved GPU units split across two delivery lanes (Dev: 60 / Prod: 140) starting Jan 1, 2027.
- Rebalance pricing: lower committed unit price for Prod slab, introduce a higher overage rate for burst usage.
- Update SOW (Exhibit C) to add integration window (30 days) and acceptance criteria tied to the new perf benchmarks.
- One-time implementation credit to offset migration costs.

Can you confirm:
1) Whether Redwood can reflect a slabed price schedule in an order form amendment rather than an Exhibit rewrite;
2) Any required language for our EU data residency clause to stay intact; and
3) A plausible commercial + legal turnaround so we can lock the Jan 1 effective date.

We'd like a mutual action plan (MAP) to track signoff, implementation, and a DocuSign route.

Thanks — attaching the files.

Attachments: HealthSpan_Amendment_Draft_v1.docx (docx), HealthSpan_Amendment_Redlines.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Maria Garcia
Senior Procurement Manager | HealthSpan
procurement@healthspan.com
+1 415-555-0192
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Garcia <maria.garcia@healthspan.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2026 08:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Order form amendment — capacity split & SOW update

Thanks Maria — got the docs. Looping in Karthik for commercial and Laura for legal/ops alignment. Quick notes so we're aligned internally:

- Goal: amend Order Form to add 200 reserved GPUs with a two-lane allocation (Dev/Prod) and updated fee schedule effective 2027-01-01.
- HealthSpan wants slab pricing and an implementation credit; also wants acceptance criteria in Exhibit C (SOW) and a shortened acceptance window (30 days).
- Maria flagged EU data residency — Laura, please confirm MSA footprint implications.

Action items:
- Karthik: propose clean commercial text for the amendment + a suggested fee table. Include one-time credit and proration language.
- Laura: triage their redlines and flag any MSA changes required (DPA/KMS/data residency). Also propose execution path (DocuSign + who signs).
- I'll coordinate MAP and schedule a quick 30-minute call with HealthSpan once we have Karthik's numbers and Laura's legal touchpoints.

I've added a short list of clarifying questions as an attachment (HealthSpan_AMD_Questions.txt). Maria — if you can answer Q2 (which EU locations are in-scope) that will speed legal review.

Thanks,
Irene
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Garcia <maria.garcia@healthspan.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Order form amendment — capacity split & SOW update

Irene / Laura / Maria — attaching a commercial proposal (HF-Commercial-Proposal_20261215.xlsx). TL;DR of my recommended approach:

- Keep the MSA intact; add an Order Form amendment that contains: (a) a slabed fee table for committed Prod capacity (0-99, 100-199, 200+ units) with stepped pricing; (b) Dev lane billed at a discounted dev rate; (c) a 6-month promotional one-time implementation credit of $45,000 applied as a sequential credit on the first 3 invoices.
- Overage pricing: set a higher per-token / per-minute surcharge for burst usage to preserve unit economics.
- Acceptance: propose a 30-day functional acceptance window tied to a short test plan (we'll include a 5-point perf checklist in Exhibit C).
- SLA exception request: HealthSpan is asking for phased rollout (Prod ramp over 60 days). If legal signs off, we can include a phased SLA with a graduated uptime target during ramp.

HubSpot: added notes to deal HS-2026-217 and uploaded the XLSX.

Maria — confirm if the implementation credit should be a fixed credit or tied to successful passing of acceptance tests (my preference: fixed credit to simplify invoicing).

Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: HF-Commercial-Proposal_20261215.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Garcia <maria.garcia@healthspan.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Order form amendment — capacity split & SOW update

Thanks all — reviewed the draft and Karthik's proposal. I attached a legal redline (HealthSpan_AMD_Redline_legal.docx) and a short ops runbook template (amendment-implementation-runbook.md) for implementation owners. Key legal notes below:

1) MSA/Order Form approach — acceptable. Amend via Order Form to capture fee slab and lane split; reference Exhibit C for SOW edits.
2) Billing/proration — call out prorated charges for mid-month effective dates and ensure the one-time implementation credit flows as a credit line on invoice not as a rebate.
3) Data residency — keep existing MSA language but add an Exhibit reference to list in-scope EU regions. Maria: please confirm which EU sites must be covered; we'll add a short clause preserving HealthSpan's residency requirement.
4) SLA ramp — legal OK with a phased SLA if we include a clear ramp schedule and defined fallbacks (e.g., auto-failover to hosted region).
5) Signature block — request the amendment include an explicit signatory for "Customer: HealthSpan, Legal" and a Redwood counter-sign document. We prefer DocuSign route; see link below.

Next steps (actions I need):
- Finalize legal redline and return to HealthSpan as a tracked change doc.
- Connor: can you pick up the runbook and fill the implementation checklist (ops owner, feature flags, rollback plan, contact matrix)?
- Irene/Karthik: confirm commercial text and whether the implementation credit is unconditional. Once we have confirmation on EU locations, I'll finalize the redline and prepare DocuSign envelope.

DocuSign envelope (draft): https://app.docusign.com/healthspan/amendment/12345
HubSpot notes: https://hubspot.com/deal/HS-2026-217
Drive (redline + runbook): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cHealthSpanAmend
